dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: I need to practice more... I want to beat my high score...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'd like to give it a shot...

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: Huh? Brilliant! I've been waiting so long for someone who's actually willing to play... A perfect competitive sport like this deserves to be practiced constantly. After all, there's always a higher peak to climb!

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: Come on, give it a shot! Who knows? You might just beat my high score!

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: Right? I custom-made every single one of these darts and boards. Beautiful, aren't they? I hunted down rare materials from all over the world just to craft them.

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: A sturdier tip, a perfectly balanced barrel, and a board carved by my own two hands. Every time I upgrade my gear, I wish for a higher score...

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: It's sad that my score just refuses to budge... So, I have no choice but to completely rework my setup all over again.

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: ...What drives me absolutely crazy is that some people can just walk up with some cheap darts from a street vendor and effortlessly land a higher score than me! It's just so frustrating!

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: No worries. I'm going to get back to practice.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, let's look at the scores...

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: I can't believe you actually beat my score... That was unreal! You're officially my hero! No, you're my new guiding light in the world of competitive darts!

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: Please, take these. Think of them as a small token of appreciation for my ultimate idol.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, let's look at the scores...

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: That score is insane... I could never pull off something like that.

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: If you have any secret tricks, please, you've got to teach me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So, let's look at the scores...

dialogues.speaker: Artem
dialogues.text: Don't sweat it! After all, I had fair share of terrible scores before finally becoming a pro dart player!
